audit.why: 47.56% over 3692 games — a losing matchup for Sylas.

HARD 8/10 is right: Vex's passive fears and interrupts dashers, and both Sylas W and E are dashes; she out-ranges him at 1200 with Mistral Bolt and shields his burst with Personal Space. His engage pattern is her kit's designed target.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two chart layers argue: full says Vex on all seven rows (consistent with HARD 8/10 and the 47.56% win rate), content win[] says Sylas on all seven. The packet's own defect line flags its Sylas-7/7 levelChart as contradicting the data.
audit.why: The kit decides it: her anti-dash fear passive, 16s W shield, and 1200-range Q counter Sylas's dash-dependent pattern at every stage; the full layer's Vex verdict matches the win rate and difficulty. Content win[] flipped to Vex with all seven whys rewritten to match, and full-layer whys (which described Sylas winning under Vex rows) rewritten to agree with their own sides.
